description: Language-neutral contract for the tools Corsen Context exposes to AI agents. This file describes the contract only - never the implementation. Every runtime (TypeScript core, PHP WordPress plugin) implements these tools independently and is mechanically checked against this manifest. Transports that serve this contract: MCP over HTTP (JSON-RPC 2.0), WebMCP (document.modelContext) and llms.txt discovery.

tools.name: search_site
tools.description: Search site content by keyword. Returns matching pages with snippets.

tools.name: get_page_content
tools.description: Get full page content as clean markdown with metadata (title, description, dates).

tools.name: list_content
tools.description: List content by type (page, post, product) with pagination.

type.description: Content type (e.g., post, page, product, or any custom type)

tools.name: get_sitemap
tools.description: Get a structured sitemap of public content with URLs, titles, types, and dates.
